top_choice_rationale: P001 honours one mature, independently confirmed discovery chain: GLP-1 physiology and incretin effect (Holst), the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov) and receptor biology with therapeutic rationale (Drucker). Large randomized trials in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes confirm the mechanism. A citation anchored in physiology and the active form, with therapy as the consequence, makes the exclusion of Knudsen a principled boundary between discovery and development. The costs remain: Mojsov's priority against Habener and other early peptide workers cannot be verified from the supplied record, and the three-person cap leaves out Knudsen's long-acting agonist engineering. I judge these acceptable, and an award is clearly preferable to no award.
